title: Review of Healthcare Services Act 2020 to Enhance Recognition and Regulation of Mental Health Professionals
what_it_is: Review of Healthcare Services Act 2020 to Enhance Recognition and Regulation of Mental Health Professionals

sections.label: Psychologist registration and advertising controls
sections.summary: MOH is updating risk assessment, including possible psychologist registration, and engaging psychologists on advertising controls and term use.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) is working with agencies, service providers and professional associations to update the risk assessment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This includes determining if there is a need for registration of psychologists to better support the safety and quality of the practice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The advertising controls under the Healthcare Services Act, or HCSA, were put in place to provide greater transparency and protect consumers from being misled by healthcare advertisements which misrepresent the services provided.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The restrictions on the use of the term “treat” applies to all non-HCSA licensees, and not just standalone psychology service providers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Likewise, the protection of the title “doctor” applies to all non-registered healthcare practitioners and not just clinical psychologists.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH is presently engaging with the psychologists and their association to clarify the proper use of these terms.

sections.label: Allied health professionals policy participation
sections.summary: Allied Health Professionals, including psychologists, participate in policy development through MOH employment, panels, consultative entities and research.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Today, Allied Health Professionals, including psychologists and other healthcare professionals can and do participate in policy development – some of them are employed directly through MOH or some of its entities, some of them come and sit on our panels and our consultative entities and they already participate in research.
